When will I hear about my 2013-14 financial aid?
Questions?
Ask Finaid!
The Office of Student Financial Services (OSFS) is committed to notifying you of your financial aid awards as soon as possible. Awarding is a complex process tied to the type of student being awarded, and we are working to let you know as quickly as we can.
Here is the timeline by which we plan to begin providing 2013-14 Financial Aid Notifications to students who have submitted FAFSAs and any documents we have requested to follow up on their FAFSAs:

Late March Prospective Freshmen
Eary April Prospective Graduate Students
Mid April Prospective Freshmen in PACE (ACC and UT co-enrollment) program
Prospective Transfer Students
Late April Continuing Undergraduate and Graduate Students registered for Summer
Late May Continuing Undergraduate and Graduate Students for Fall and Spring
(after Fall/Spring tuition is set by the Board of Regents)

Watch your email or check CASH around these dates because failure to accept your awards in a timely manner may cause you to forfeit them.
Awards for prospective and continuing students come out of different funding pools, so no continuing students will lose out on any financial aid because we are awarding prospective students first.
